reference_translation: Tieguanyin, a well-known Chinese tea, is a type of oolong tea. It is produced in Anxi County, Fujian Province. Tieguanyin has a unique flavor and rich aroma. Its taste is mellow and sweet, leaving a long-lasting aftertaste. Drinking Tieguanyin not only quenches thirst but also has certain health benefits, such as helping digestion and reducing fat. In June 2021, Tieguanyin traditional tea-making techniques and associated social practices were included in the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity by UNESCO.
